scripts.render: npm run tokens && remotion render NoteWasNeverThePoint out/.raw.mp4 && npm run loudness
scripts.loudness: remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/note-was-never-the-point.mp4
